key_terms.التَّقْوَى: God-consciousness, piety, and guarding oneself through obedience to Allah
key_terms.الزَّادِ: provision or supplies prepared for a journey

ai.seo_question: What is the best provision for the Hereafter in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the finest provision a person can carry is taqwa, especially for the journey to the Hereafter. It emphasizes inner piety and God-consciousness over worldly forms of provision.
